title: Saved engineering interfaces inherit Wright theme and reconnect their frame
summary: Actual settings controls and saved model-created interfaces; no process start, review or global preference save.

manualSteps.label: Open interface
manualSteps.instruction: Open the saved Heat or Focus-wheel working-interface link.

manualSteps.label: Choose light theme
manualSteps.instruction: Click Back to Dashboard, then Settings. Choose Light Theme. Leave Save Preferences untouched.

manualSteps.label: Return to interface
manualSteps.instruction: Use browser Back twice to return to the saved working interface.

manualSteps.label: Reload frame
manualSteps.instruction: Reload the embedded page using the browser frame-reload action. Inspect the same exact results.

manualSteps.label: Restore theme
manualSteps.instruction: Repeat the Settings route, choose Dark Theme, then return. Leave all reviews unchanged.
